🆕 New listing (published August 11, 2026)

33rd Agano Shuku Festival. August 22 (Saturday, Reiwa 8), 4:00 PM – 9:00 PM, at Agano Shuku (around Sakaishi-cho, Hanno City). A 3-minute walk from Agano Station on the Seibu Railway Ikebukuro Line. Fireworks display at 8:30 PM. Event proceeds rain or shine; cancelled only in case of severe weather. Temporary parking at Hanno City Okumitake Elementary School. Heavy congestion is expected in the area, so public transportation is recommended.
